## Validation

- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] Fixture outputs remain deterministic and suggestions remain correction-friendly.
- [ ] HTML remains script-free and accessible.
- [ ] No private metadata, credentials, employment data, partner/customer data, or sensitive person information is included.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated when behavior changes.
